name: harness-addons
description: Exposes the agent-toolkit MCP server (notes, todos, timers, and projects) as harness add-ons. Provides persistent markdown notes with full-text search, project-scoped todos, durable timers, and a cross-project registry.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent notes, todos, timers, and project registry via agent-toolkit
interface.longDescription: Installs the agent-toolkit MCP server, giving Claude Code persistent markdown notes with FTS5 full-text search, project-scoped todo lists, durable scheduled timers, and a cross-project registry with per-project docs.
